Prior rulings read: maintainer ruling on #35315 (which objects offer Change Owner, seven points, comment 7000907189: a `controlled_by_parent` detail's ownership follows its master, transfer off by derived default) · maintainer p1 grading on this card · triage 7001505437. Executes the interim the ruling implies; no conflict.
Serial constraints cleared: live overlap scan of every open PR's files: none touches `user-assigned-work` or `UserAssignedWorkPanel` (#35220 included); the dev runs overlap-check before the first push.
Scope: the hand-over no longer moves `owner_id` on an object whose access is `controlled_by_parent`; those records are still counted (shown as not handed over) if the existing shape allows it without a new public contract, otherwise left out with the reason stated; app-authored user fields and `owner_id` on other objects unchanged. Pins: a detail's `owner_id` not transferred, a master's still transferred, an app-authored user field on the detail still transferred; ablation. `Fixes #35344` (the rest lives in #35399).
